name: domain.ci_pipeline
description: CI/CD pipeline workflow linter, circular job dependency detector, and action security auditor

entrypoints.name: validate_github_actions_workflow
entrypoints.description: Validate GitHub Actions YAML workflow structure (name, on trigger, jobs, permissions)

entrypoints.name: find_circular_job_dependencies

entrypoints.name: audit_action_pins
entrypoints.description: Audit third-party GitHub Actions for mutable tags (e.g. @v3) vs immutable commit SHA pins
